title: VP Duterte witness admits never visiting Cale88 plant

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo, a defense witness who testified on Friday during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, admitted he had never personally visited the plant of Cale88 Foods Corp. and had no personal knowledge of its actual operations. House prosecution counsel Erwin Matib drew the admission from Rodolfo, who is the managing head of the Board of Investments (BOI), while examining the basis of the BOI records presented during the trial. Rodolfo had identified documents concerning Cale88’s registered project, reports of operations, and changes in ownership during the defense’s presentation.
